I told Marcus the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is 10 June, replying in a thread on his #north-team message.

Ilse first posted 25 November in #north-team on 14 Oct. A correction from her to 10 June is in #north-random, timestamped the same morning; she said she'd read the wrong line. Marcus is in both channels, so he could already see the correction. I also told him to ignore my earlier 25 November confirmation in #north-team.

I didn't use gbrain, since it was refusing all reads last time. There are still no account files for Brackenwater, so 10 June rests only on Ilse's correction; I haven't checked it against a contract.
